## Setup for annotation processing 


```{r}

# custom function to calculate standard error
se=function(data){
  return(sd(data, na.rm = T)/sqrt(sum(!is.na(data))))
}

# mapping for labels to numeric values
label_map <- c("ic" = -1, "f" = 0, "ok" = 1)

# function to extract proportions for a given rater column
process_props <- function(sheet_name, col) {
  expected_size <- sample_sizes[[sheet_name]]
  actual_size <- sum(!is.na(col))
  if (actual_size != expected_size) {
    warning(paste("Expected sample size", expected_size, "but got", actual_size, "in sheet", sheet_name))
  }
  pt <- prop.table(table(col))
  ok_p <- if ("1" %in% names(pt)) pt[["1"]] else NA
  f_p  <- if ("0" %in% names(pt)) pt[["0"]] else NA
  ic_p <- if ("-1" %in% names(pt)) pt[["-1"]] else NA
  list(ok_p = ok_p, f_p = f_p, ic_p = ic_p)
}


# function to calculate proportions, SE, and IRR for all rater columns in a sheet
calculate_all_proportions <- function(sheet_name, data) {
  df <- read_excel(data, sheet = sheet_name) |>
    select(matches("^rater_\\d+$"))
  
  raters <- grep("^rater_", names(df), value = TRUE)
  
  valid_labels <- c("ic", "f", "ok")
  df <- df |>
    mutate(
      across(all_of(raters), ~ {
        x <- tolower(.)
        bad_vals <- setdiff(unique(x), valid_labels)
        if (length(bad_vals) > 0) {
          warning(paste(
            "Unexpected label(s) found in rater columns:",
            paste(bad_vals, collapse = ", ")
          ))
        }
        x
      })
    )
  
  df <- df |> mutate(across(all_of(raters), ~ recode(., !!!label_map)))
  
  kappa_result <- irrCAC::krippen.alpha.raw(df, weights = "ordinal")$est
  
  kappa_conf_int <- kappa_result$conf.int |>
    gsub(pattern = "\\(|\\)", replacement = "", x = _) |>
    strsplit(split = ",") |>
    unlist() |>
    as.numeric() |>
    (\(x) paste0("(", round(x[1], 2), ", ", round(x[2], 2), ")"))()
  
  all_p_and_se <- lapply(df[raters], function(col) process_props(sheet_name, col))
  
  mean_props <- sapply(c("ok_p", "f_p", "ic_p"), function(x)
    mean(sapply(all_p_and_se, `[[`, x), na.rm = TRUE)
  )
  
  # pool all rater columns to compute a single SE
  pooled_col <- unlist(df[raters])
  se_pooled <- se(pooled_col)

  data.frame(
    benchmark = benchmark_names[[sheet_name]],
    rater_no = as.character(length(raters)),
    kappa_val = round(kappa_result$coeff.val, 2),
    ok_p = mean_props["ok_p"],
    f_p  = mean_props["f_p"],
    ic_p = mean_props["ic_p"],
    se   = se_pooled,
    kappa_se = kappa_result$coeff.se,
    kappa_conf_int = kappa_conf_int,
    kappa_p_value = kappa_result$p.value)
}
```

## Calculate proportions and IRR for all data

```{r}
options(scipen=999)

# initialize empty data frame for output
res_df <- data.frame(
  benchmark = character(),
  rater_no = character(),
  kappa_val = numeric(),
  ok_p = numeric(),
  f_p = numeric(),
  ic_p = numeric(),
  se = numeric(),
  kappa_se = numeric(),
  kappa_conf_int = character(),
  kappa_p_value = numeric()
)

# combine results across sheets
res_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(
  c("winogrande_is_random_sample", "scala_is_random_sample", "arc_is_random_sample", "iceEC_random_sample",
    "icelandic_qa_random_sample", "belebele_is_random_sample", "multiwikiqa_is_random_sample", "arc_challenge_is_random_sample", "ged_is_random_sample", "nqii_random_sample", "mmlu_is_random_sample", "hellaswag_is_random_sample"),
  \(sheet) {
    cat(paste("Processing sheet:", sheet, "\n"))
    calculate_all_proportions(sheet, data)
  }
))


``` 

## Plot results

```{r}
res_long <- res_df |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(ok_p, f_p, ic_p),
    names_to = "label_type",
    values_to = "proportion"
  ) |>
  
  mutate(
    label_type = factor(label_type, levels = c("ic_p", "f_p", "ok_p"),
                        labels = c("IC", "F", "OK"))
  )

ggplot(res_long, aes(x = label_type, y = proportion, color = label_type)) +
  geom_point(size = 4, position = position_dodge(width = 0.4)) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = proportion - se * 1.96, ymax = proportion + se * 1.96),
    width = 0.1,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.4)
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = round(proportion, 2)),
    # position = position_dodge(width = 0.4),
    hjust="inward",
    vjust = ifelse(res_long$proportion > 0.8, 1.5, -1.5),
    size = 4,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = 2) +
  ylim(0, 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Label Proportions per Benchmark",
    x = "",
    y = "Mean Proportion (± SE)",
    color = "Label Type"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("IC" = "#440154", "F" = "#21918c", "OK" = "#5ec962")
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.2, 0.2))) +
  facet_wrap(~factor(benchmark,levels=c("GED", "Winogrande-is", "IcelandicQA", "ScaLA", "IceErrorCorpus", "NQiI", "ARC-Challenge-is", "MultiWikiQA-is", "Belebele-is", "ARC-is", "MMLU-is","HellaSwag-is")), nrow = 2) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    aspect.ratio = 1,
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "right"
  )
ggsave("mean_proportions.png", width=12, height=6)
```


## Proportion per rater 

```{r}
calculate_proportions_per_rater <- function(sheet_name, data) {
  df <- read_excel(data, sheet = sheet_name) |>
    select(matches("^rater_\\d+$"))
  
  raters <- grep("^rater_", names(df), value = TRUE)
  
  valid_labels <- c("ic", "f", "ok")
  df <- df |>
    mutate(
      across(all_of(raters), ~ {
        x <- tolower(.)
        bad_vals <- setdiff(unique(x), valid_labels)
        if (length(bad_vals) > 0) {
          warning(paste(
            "Unexpected label(s) found in rater columns:",
            paste(bad_vals, collapse = ", ")
          ))
        }
        x
      })
    )
  
  df <- df |> mutate(across(all_of(raters), ~ recode(., !!!label_map)))
  
  rater_proportions <- sapply(df[raters], function(col) process_props(sheet_name, col))
  
  rater_df <- data.frame(
    benchmark = benchmark_names[[sheet_name]],
    ok_p = rater_proportions["ok_p", ],
    f_p  = rater_proportions["f_p", ],
    ic_p = rater_proportions["ic_p",]
  )
  return(rater_df)
}
  
rater_res_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(
  c("winogrande_is_random_sample", "scala_is_random_sample", "arc_is_random_sample", "iceEC_random_sample",
    "icelandic_qa_random_sample", "belebele_is_random_sample", "multiwikiqa_is_random_sample", "arc_challenge_is_random_sample", "ged_is_random_sample", "nqii_random_sample", "mmlu_is_random_sample", "hellaswag_is_random_sample"),
  \(sheet) {
    cat(paste("Processing sheet for rater proportions:", sheet, "\n"))
    calculate_proportions_per_rater(sheet, data)
  }
))




```

## Plot rater proportions across all benchmarks

```{r}
rater_res_long <- rater_res_df |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -benchmark,
    names_to = c("label_type", "rater"),
    names_pattern = "(ok|f|ic)_p\\.(rater_\\d+)",
    values_to = "proportion"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    label_type = factor(label_type, levels = c("ic", "f", "ok"),
                        labels = c("IC", "F", "OK"))
  )

ggplot(rater_res_long, aes(x = label_type, y = proportion, group = rater)) +
  geom_point(aes(shape=rater, color = rater), size = 3, position = position_dodge(width = 0.4)) +
  guides(shape = guide_legend(title = "Rater"), color = guide_legend(title = "Rater")) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = 2) +
  ylim(0, 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Label Proportions per Rater",
    x = "",
    y = "Proportion"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("rater_1" = "#440154", "rater_2" = "#21918c", "rater_3" = "#5ec962"),
    labels = c("rater_1" = "Rater 1", "rater_2" = "Rater 2", "rater_3" = "Rater 3")

   scale_shape_manual(

    labels = c("rater_1" = "Rater 1", "rater_2" = "Rater 2", "rater_3" = "Rater 3")
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.2, 0.2))) +
  facet_wrap(~factor(benchmark,levels=c("GED", "Winogrande-is", "IcelandicQA", "ScaLA", "IceErrorCorpus", "NQiI", "ARC-Challenge-is", "MultiWikiQA-is", "Belebele-is", "ARC-is", "MMLU-is","HellaSwag-is")), nrow = 3) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    aspect.ratio = 1,
```
